review_comments: Seems this limitation is too strong, normally, one table only will have one or two uk.
It does not limit how many indexes a table can have. This means if there is a SQL like `add index i1, add unique index i2`, it will fallback to add them sequentially.
whey will it be a slice, didn't found it
would be better to have an explicit `unique` field, ok for now
